corrections: Election ordering prefers the larger peerEpoch, then zxid, then sid. Original zxid comparison was reversed and omitted peerEpoch; electionEpoch is a distinct logical election round.

WorkerSender and WorkerReceiver descriptions were swapped in the original overview. Actual socket reader class is RecvWorker, and the two incoming queues contain Message and Notification respectively.
QuorumPeer.run and QuorumCnxManager.startConnection headings were corrected. Restored two truncated logging statements from pinned source.
Majority wording is qualified for standard majority ensembles; checks use the configured QuorumVerifier.
Election connection ID tie-break operates after TCP establishment, retaining the connection initiated by the higher sid.
Leader initialization counts a quorum including the leader; it does not require a majority of followers alone.
Epoch ACKEPOCH and synchronized NEWLEADER ACK are distinct barriers. Server startup follows NEWLEADER quorum acknowledgment, rather than LEADERINFO acknowledgment.
UPTODATE ends synchronization; replay and NEWLEADER may precede it. Committed-log and applied-database watermarks do not alone establish whether a transaction is awaiting quorum acknowledgment.
Netty channelActive creates a connection object before session negotiation; plaintext excerpts do not exclude SSL handlers in the complete pipeline. Restored original sendPkt missing semicolon.
Three-peer local example adds explicit tickTime/initLimit/syncLimit, separate data directories, myid creation commands, and disables optional AdminServer to prevent a shared HTTP-port conflict.
